run_diatomic_tests: run diatomic potential energy curve tests for a pretrained MLIP model and save plots
compute_diatomic_curve: compute the diatomic potential energy curve for two atoms across a range of distances
get_model: load a pretrained MLIP model either from a released checkpoint or a local path
generate_plot: generate a potential energy curve plot for a diatomic molecule and save as PNG
combined_plot: generate a combined plot showing multiple diatomic potential energy curves on one figure
